notes.title: A FISTFUL OF VERSION 1.04
notes.content:
Updates:


 Thanks to the wonderful Will (@schmooDev) we managed to drastically reduce the performance struggles in the last level of the game :)
 The game now boots into fullscreen mode. If you already have the game donwloaded, it won't overwrite your current fullscreen settings, but it means that new downloads on Steamdeck (and any other lower resolution screens) will boot into a fullscreen that doesn't cut anything off the screen.
 You can now remap the special button in the input options of the pause menu.
 Updated the description of the Explosive Challenge achievement to be more specific. It now reads "don't explode any red barrels in The Valley".


Thanks y'all! And thanks for all the great reviews on Steam!!! Reviews make a huge difference to Steams algorithm and I love reading them.

- fffrog3
